   AND TRAFFIC SERVICE CENTER.
2. PAIR 96-HOUR NOTIFICATION SHOULD BE SENT TO ONE OF THE
   ADDRESSES BELOW:
   A. VESSELS INBOUND TO CANADIAN WATERS ON THE EAST COAST
      INCLUDING A CANADIAN OR AMERICAN PORT IN THE GREAT LAKES
      SHALL SEND A PAIR TO ECAREG CANADA VIA ONE OF THE FOLLOWING

          EMAIL: HLXECAREG1@INNAV.GC.CA

      COMPLETED.

      CALLS AT MARINE FACILITIES.
